question: How many films are in the catalog?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film

question: How many films are there in each category?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, count(*) FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name

question: What are the top 5 customers by total amount paid? Show the total.
gold_sql: SELECT sum(p.amount) AS total FROM payment p GROUP BY p.customer_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which actor has appeared in the most films, and in how many?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS film_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id ORDER BY film_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average rental rate of films for each rating?
gold_sql: SELECT rating, round(avg(rental_rate), 2) FROM film GROUP BY rating

question: How many rentals were made in each month?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM rental GROUP BY date_trunc('month', rental_date)

question: Which 5 countries have the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT co.country FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id GROUP BY co.country ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which films have never been rented?
gold_sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory i JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id WHERE i.film_id = f.film_id)

question: How many films are rated PG-13 and longer than 120 minutes?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film WHERE rating = 'PG-13' AND length > 120

question: What is the average film length in each category?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, round(avg(f.length), 2) FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = fc.film_id GROUP BY c.name

question: How many distinct films does each store carry in its inventory?
gold_sql: SELECT store_id, count(DISTINCT film_id) FROM inventory GROUP BY store_id

question: How many films are there in each language?
gold_sql: SELECT l.name, count(*) FROM film f JOIN language l ON l.language_id = f.language_id GROUP BY l.name

question: What are the top 5 film categories by total revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = i.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY sum(p.amount) DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many actors have the last name Kilmer?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM actor WHERE last_name = 'KILMER'

question: List the titles of films that Penelope Guiness acted in.
gold_sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id JOIN actor a ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id WHERE a.first_name = 'PENELOPE' AND a.last_name = 'GUINESS'

question: How many rentals has each staff member processed?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM rental GROUP BY staff_id

question: Which film categories have more than 150 films?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING count(*) > 150

question: What is the total payment revenue per month?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(amount) FROM payment GROUP BY date_trunc('month', payment_date)

question: How many customers have made more than 40 rentals?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM rental GROUP BY customer_id HAVING count(*) > 40) t

question: Which country has the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT co.country FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id GROUP BY co.country ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average replacement cost of films by rating?
gold_sql: SELECT rating, round(avg(replacement_cost), 2) FROM film GROUP BY rating

question: How many films include 'Deleted Scenes' as a special feature?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film WHERE 'Deleted Scenes' = ANY (special_features)

question: How many films are in the Sci-Fi category?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film_category fc JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Sci-Fi'

question: How many films have the rating NC-17?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film WHERE rating = 'NC-17'

question: How many customers do we have in total?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customer

question: What is the longest film length in minutes?
gold_sql: SELECT max(length) FROM film

question: How many customers are inactive?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customer WHERE active = 0

question: How many rentals were made in 2022?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM rental WHERE extract(year FROM rental_date) = 2022

question: What is the total payment revenue in each year?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(amount) FROM payment GROUP BY extract(year FROM payment_date)

question: How many distinct customers have rented a film in the Horror category?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT r.customer_id) FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = i.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Horror'

question: Which 3 cities have the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT ci.city FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id GROUP BY ci.city_id, ci.city ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many actors have appeared in at least 40 films?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT actor_id FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id HAVING count(*) >= 40) t

question: How many films have a rental rate above 3 dollars and a length under 90 minutes?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film WHERE rental_rate > 3 AND length < 90

question: What is the total revenue from customers living in Canada?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(p.amount) FROM payment p JOIN customer cu ON cu.customer_id = p.customer_id JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id WHERE co.country = 'Canada'

question: How many customers have spent more than the average customer?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id, sum(amount) AS total FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id) t WHERE total > (SELECT avg(total) FROM (SELECT sum(amount) AS total FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id) x)

question: How many films have been rented more times than the average film?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT i.film_id, count(*) AS n FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id GROUP BY i.film_id) t WHERE n > (SELECT avg(n) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id GROUP BY i.film_id) x)

question: What percentage of total revenue does each film category contribute? Round to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT round((sum(p.amount) * 100.0 / (SELECT sum(amount) FROM payment WHERE rental_id IS NOT NULL))::numeric, 2) FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY fc.category_id

question: In each month, how many customers made their first ever rental?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id, min(rental_date) AS first_rental FROM rental GROUP BY customer_id) t GROUP BY date_trunc('month', first_rental)

question: How many customers have never made a single payment above 5 dollars?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customer cu WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.customer_id = cu.customer_id AND p.amount > 5)

question: What is the average number of days a film is kept before it is returned? Give a plain number rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT round(avg(extract(epoch FROM (return_date - rental_date)) / 86400)::numeric, 2) FROM rental WHERE return_date IS NOT NULL

question: Which actor has generated the most revenue from rentals of the films they appeared in?
gold_sql: SELECT a.actor_id FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = fa.film_id JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id GROUP BY a.actor_id ORDER BY sum(p.amount) DESC LIMIT 1
